pretreatment: Thermal treatment at different temperatures (250°C, 400°C, 500°C, 600°C, 800°C, 1000°C) and hydrolytic removal of Cl- groups after reaction with VOCl3
surface_functionalization: Hydroxyl groups (SiOH) on the SiO2 surface are involved in the formation of different vanadium(V) oxide surface phases
evidence: In dependence on the SiOH-group concentration of the Aerosil surface two different disperse vanadium(V) oxide phases are obtained, which differ characteristically in their reflection spectra, their chemisorption behaviour towards butene and their catalytic properties in the oxidation of butene and ethanol.
